name: outline_collections_add_group
description: Add a group to a collection. This method allows you to give all members in a group access to a collection.

name: outline_collections_add_user
description: Add a collection user. This method allows you to add a user membership to the specified collection.

id.description: Identifier for the collection

userId.description: Identifier for the user to add to the collection

name: outline_collections_archive
description: Archive a collection. Archiving a collection hides it, and all of the documents within it, from the sidebar and search results. Archived collections can be restored at a later date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

anyOf.description: An optional reason for archiving the collection. This is stored and returned as `deprecatedReason`.

name: outline_collections_create
description: Create a collection. Create a new collection with the specified name, description, icon, color, and permission settings. Collections are used to organize documents.

color.description: A hex color code for the collection icon

data.description: The collection description as a rich-text ProseMirror JSON document. Only one of `description` or `data` may be provided.

description.description: A brief description of the collection, markdown supported. Only one of `description` or `data` may be provided.

icon.description: A string that represents an icon in the outline-icons package or an emoji

sharing.description: Whether public sharing of documents is allowed

name: outline_collections_delete
description: Delete a collection. Delete a collection and all of its documents. This action can’t be undone so please be careful.

anyOf.description: An optional reason for deleting the collection. This is stored and returned as `deprecatedReason`.

name: outline_collections_documents
description: Retrieve a collections document structure. Returns the document structure of a collection as a tree of navigation nodes, representing the hierarchy of documents within the collection.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

name: outline_collections_duplicate
description: Duplicate a collection. Duplicate an existing collection along with its published documents. The original collection's settings – icon, color, permission, sharing, and sorting – are preserved on the copy. Draft and archived documents are not duplicated. Document duplication runs asynchronously in the background, so the copy may initially be returned before all of its documents have been created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection to duplicate.

name.description: An optional name for the new collection. If omitted, the original collection's name is reused.

name: outline_collections_group_memberships
description: List all collection group members. This method allows you to list a collections group memberships. This is the list of groups that have been given access to the collection.

id.description: Identifier for the collection

name: outline_collections_info
description: Retrieve a collection. Retrieve the details of a collection by its unique identifier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

name: outline_collections_list
description: List all collections. List all collections that the authenticated user has access to.

CollectionFilter.description: A single filter node for `/collections.list`, either a leaf condition matching a collection field or a group combining nested filters with a logical operator.

oneOf.description: A condition that compares a collection field against a value.

field.description: Name of the collection field to filter on.

operator.description: Comparison operator to apply. Note that some fields only accept a subset of operators – for example `permission` only supports `eq`, `neq`, `in`, `notIn`, `isNull` and `isNotNull`.

value.description: Value to compare against. May be a string, boolean or array of these depending on the field and operator. Date fields accept an ISO 8601 date or an ISO 8601 duration (relative to now). `permission` accepts a `Permission` enum value (or an array with `in`/`notIn`). Omit for `isNull` and `isNotNull`.

oneOf.description: A logical group that combines nested filters with an `AND` or `OR` operator. Groups may themselves contain further groups.

filters.description: Structured filter expression, evaluated as an AND of top-level entries. Cannot be combined with the deprecated `query` or `statusFilter` parameters.

query.description: If set, will filter the results by collection name. Deprecated – prefer the `filters` parameter.

statusFilter.description: An optional array of statuses to filter by. Deprecated – prefer the `filters` parameter.

name: outline_collections_memberships
description: List all collection memberships. This method allows you to list a collections individual memberships. It's important to note that memberships returned from this endpoint do not include group memberships.

id.description: Identifier for the collection

name: outline_collections_move
description: Move a collection. Move a collection to a new position in the sidebar. Collections are ordered using a fractional index; provide the new index to reposition the collection relative to its siblings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

index.description: The fractional index to move the collection to, used for ordering in the sidebar.

name: outline_collections_remove_group
description: Remove a collection group. This method allows you to revoke all members in a group access to a collection. Note that members of the group may still retain access through other groups or individual memberships.

id.description: Identifier for the collection

name: outline_collections_remove_user
description: Remove a collection user. This method allows you to remove a user from the specified collection.

id.description: Identifier for the collection

userId.description: Identifier for the user to remove from the collection

name: outline_collections_restore
description: Restore an archived collection. Restore a previously archived collection, making it and the documents within it visible in the sidebar and search results once again.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

name: outline_collections_update
description: Update a collection. Update an existing collection's properties such as name, description, icon, color, sharing settings, or permission level.

color.description: A hex color code for the collection icon

data.description: The collection description as a rich-text ProseMirror JSON document. Only one of `description` or `data` may be provided.

anyOf.description: The reason the collection was archived. Can only be updated on an archived collection.

description.description: A brief description of the collection, markdown supported. Only one of `description` or `data` may be provided.

icon.description: A string that represents an icon in the outline-icons package or an emoji

sharing.description: Whether public sharing of documents is allowed

name: outline_comments_add_reaction
description: Add a reaction to a comment. Add an emoji reaction to a comment on behalf of the authenticated user.

emoji.description: A native emoji to react with, for example `😄`.

id.description: Unique identifier for the comment.

name: outline_comments_create
description: Create a comment. Add a comment or reply to a document, either `data` or `text` is required. Provide `anchorText` to create an inline comment attached to a specific text range in the document.

anchorPrefix.description: Text immediately preceding `anchorText`, used to disambiguate between multiple occurrences. Requires `anchorText`.

anchorSuffix.description: Text immediately following `anchorText`, used to disambiguate between multiple occurrences. Requires `anchorText`.

anchorText.description: Plain text substring to anchor the comment to as an inline comment. The first occurrence in the document's plain text is used unless disambiguated by `anchorPrefix` and/or `anchorSuffix`.

text.description: The body of the comment in markdown.

name: outline_comments_delete
description: Delete a comment. Deletes a comment. If the comment is a top-level comment, all its children will be deleted as well.

name: outline_comments_info
description: Retrieve a comment. Retrieve a comment

includeAnchorText.description: Include the document text that the comment is anchored to, if any, in the response.

name: outline_comments_list
description: List all comments. This method will list all comments matching the given properties.

includeAnchorText.description: Include the document text that the comment is anchored to, if any, in the response.

name: outline_comments_remove_reaction
description: Remove a reaction from a comment. Remove an emoji reaction that the authenticated user previously added to a comment.

emoji.description: The native emoji reaction to remove, for example `😄`.

id.description: Unique identifier for the comment.

name: outline_comments_resolve
description: Resolve a comment. Mark a comment thread as resolved. Resolved comments are hidden from the document by default and indicate that the discussion has been dealt with.

id.description: Unique identifier for the comment.

name: outline_comments_unresolve
description: Unresolve a comment. Mark a previously resolved comment thread as unresolved, making it visible on the document again.

id.description: Unique identifier for the comment.

name: outline_comments_update
description: Update a comment. Update a comment, either `data` or `text` is required.

text.description: The body of the comment in markdown.

name: outline_data_attributes_create
description: Create a data attribute. Create a new data attribute. Only admins can create data attributes.

DataAttributeDataType.description: The data type of the attribute value.

DataAttributeOptions.description: Additional options for certain data attribute types.

icon.description: An icon representing the data attribute from the outline-icons package.

options.description: Valid options for list data type.

pinned.description: Whether the data attribute is pinned to the top of document.

name: outline_data_attributes_delete
description: Delete a data attribute. Delete a data attribute. Only admins can delete data attributes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the data attribute.

name: outline_data_attributes_info
description: Retrieve a data attribute. Retrieve a data attribute by its unique identifier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the data attribute.

name: outline_data_attributes_list
description: List all data attributes. List all data attributes.

name: outline_data_attributes_update
description: Update a data attribute. Update an existing data attribute. Only admins can update data attributes. Note that the dataType cannot be changed after creation.

DataAttributeOptions.description: Additional options for certain data attribute types.

icon.description: An icon representing the data attribute from the outline-icons package.

options.description: Valid options for list data type.

pinned.description: Whether the data attribute is pinned to the top of document.

name: outline_documents_add_group
description: Add a group to a document. This method allows you to give all members in a group access to a document.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

name: outline_documents_add_user
description: Add a document user. This method allows you to add a user membership to the specified document.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

name: outline_documents_answer_question
description: Query documents with natural language. This method allows asking direct questions of your documents – where possible an answer will be provided. Search results will be restricted to those accessible by the current access token. Note that "AI answers" must be enabled for the workspace.

dateFilter.description: Any documents that have not been updated within the specified period will be filtered out

statusFilter.description: Any documents that are not in the specified status will be filtered out

userId.description: Any documents that have not been edited by the user identifier will be filtered out

name: outline_documents_archive
description: Archive a document. Archiving a document allows outdated information to be moved out of sight whilst retaining the ability to optionally search and restore it later.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

anyOf.description: An optional reason for archiving the document. This is stored and returned as `deprecatedReason`.

name: outline_documents_archived
description: List all archived documents. This method will list all archived documents belonging to the workspace that the current user has access to.

collectionId.description: Optionally filter to a specific collection

name: outline_documents_create
description: Create a document. This method allows you to create or publish a new document. By default a document is set to the collection root. If you want to create a nested/child document, you should pass parentDocumentId to set the parent document.

anyOf.description: Identifier for the collection. Required to publish unless parentDocumentId is provided. Pass the literal string `personal` to create the document in the authenticated user's personal collection.
Color for the document icon (hex format)

createdAt.description: Optionally set the created date in the past

dataAttributes.description: Data attributes to be included on the document.

dataAttributeId.description: Unique identifier for the data attribute.

value.description: The value of the data attribute. Can be a string, boolean, or number depending on the data attribute type.

fullWidth.description: Whether the document should be displayed in full width

icon.description: Icon displayed alongside the document title

id.description: Optional identifier for the document

anyOf.description: Identifier for the parent document. Required to publish unless collectionId is provided
Document-level display preferences. Only the fields supplied are updated; existing values for other preferences are preserved. Pass `null` to clear all preferences.

headingPrefix.description: Numbering style applied to the document's headings when rendered.

publish.description: Whether this document should be immediately published and made visible to other workspace members.

text.description: The body of the document in markdown

name: outline_documents_delete
description: Delete a document. Deleting a document moves it to the trash. If not restored within 30 days it is permanently deleted.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

permanent.description: If set to true the document will be destroyed with no way to recover rather than moved to the trash.

anyOf.description: An optional reason for deleting the document. This is stored and returned as `deprecatedReason`.

name: outline_documents_deleted
description: List all deleted documents. This method will list all deleted documents belonging to the workspace that the current user has access to.

DocumentsDeletedFilter.description: A single filter node for `/documents.deleted`, either a leaf condition matching a supported field or a group combining nested filters with a logical operator.

oneOf.description: A condition that compares a deleted-document field against a value.

field.description: Name of the field to filter on.

operator.description: Comparison operator to apply. `deletedById` only supports `eq` and `in`.

value.description: Value to compare against. `deletedAt` accepts an ISO 8601 date or an ISO 8601 duration (relative to now); `deletedById` accepts a user UUID (or an array of UUIDs with `in`/`notIn`). Omit for `isNull` and `isNotNull`.

oneOf.description: A logical group that combines nested filters with an `AND` or `OR` operator. Groups may themselves contain further groups.

filters.description: Structured filter expression, evaluated as an AND of top-level entries. Supported fields are `deletedAt` (date) and `deletedById` (uuid, identifier of the user who deleted the document).

name: outline_documents_documents
description: Retrieve a document's child structure. This method returns the nested document structure (tree) for the children of the specified document.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

name: outline_documents_drafts
description: List all draft documents. This method will list all draft documents belonging to the current user.

dateFilter.description: Any documents that have not been updated within the specified period will be filtered out

name: outline_documents_duplicate
description: Duplicate a document. This method allows you to duplicate an existing document and optionally all of its child documents.

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection the document should be copied to

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

parentDocumentId.description: Identifier for the parent document the document should be copied to

publish.description: Whether the new document should be published

recursive.description: Whether child documents should also be duplicated

title.description: New title for the duplicated document

name: outline_documents_group_memberships
description: List document group memberships. This method allows you to list a document's group memberships.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

name: outline_documents_info
description: Retrieve a document. Retrieve a document by its `UUID`, `urlId`, or `shareId`. At least one of these parameters must be provided.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

shareId.description: Unique identifier for a document share, a shareId may be used in place of a document UUID

name: outline_documents_insights
description: Retrieve insights for a document. Retrieve a chronologically sorted array of activity rollups (views, comments, reactions, revisions, editors) for a document. Recent activity is returned as daily rollups, while older activity is aggregated into weekly rollups. Insights must be enabled on the document. Defaults to the last 30 days when no date range is provided.

endDate.description: End of the insights window (inclusive). Defaults to today.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document.

startDate.description: Start of the insights window (inclusive). Defaults to 30 days ago.

name: outline_documents_list
description: List all documents. This method will list all published documents and draft documents belonging to the current user.

statusFilter.description: Document statuses to include in results. Deprecated – prefer the `filters` parameter.

query.description: If set, will filter the results by user name

name: outline_documents_move

index.description: The position index in the collection structure

name: outline_documents_remove_group

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

name: outline_documents_remove_user
description: Remove a document user. This method allows you to remove a user membership from the specified document.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

The color of the template icon in hex format.

data.description: The body of the template as a Prosemirror document.

fullWidth.description: Whether the template should be displayed full width.

anyOf.description: An emoji to use as the template icon.

id.description: Unique identifier for the template. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

publish.description: Set to true to publish a draft template so it becomes available to other members.
